description: The guard that holds the call that follows an approval to the files the owner was shown (stale_after_approval) and the gate that draws the card: lib/local-tools.mjs (the hold, previewChanges, the preflights), lib/permissions.mjs (when the card is drawn, what it carries, the guard of an approval), lib/manager.mjs (the guard reaches the call, also after a hook's question), judged by tests/verify-approval-preview.mjs on a real HubManager.

mutations.name: AG-hold-none
mutations.what: the guard holds nothing

mutations.name: AG-hold-sha
mutations.what: a file that changed is let through

mutations.name: AG-hold-foreign
mutations.what: a file that is not on the card is let through

mutations.name: AG-hold-executed
mutations.what: the refusal does not say that nothing was executed

mutations.name: AG-hold-code
mutations.what: the refusal has another code

mutations.name: AG-hold-deleted
mutations.what: a file that went away is not held

mutations.name: AG-hold-edit
mutations.what: an edit is not held to the card

mutations.name: AG-hold-write
mutations.what: a write is not held to the card

mutations.name: AG-hold-batch
mutations.what: a batch is not held to the card

mutations.name: AG-call-match
mutations.what: a card made for another call is accepted

mutations.name: AG-call-pass
mutations.what: the guard does not reach the tool

patches.old: return await tool.run(checked.value, { taskId, signal, guard });

mutations.name: AG-call-executed
mutations.what: a refusal that carries executed:false loses it

patches.old: return failure(info.code, info.message, error?.executed === false ? { executed: false } : {});

mutations.name: AG-preview-tools
mutations.what: every local tool is previewed

mutations.name: AG-preview-invalid
mutations.what: a call with a wrong form is previewed

mutations.name: AG-preview-guard-failed
mutations.what: a call that would be refused is held to a card

patches.old: guard: failed ? null : buildApprovalGuard(op, args ?? {}, plans) };

mutations.name: AG-gate-tools
mutations.what: the gate asks for a preview of every local tool

mutations.name: AG-gate-local
mutations.what: the gate asks for a preview of a tool that is not local
mutations.equivalent: the name of an external tool carries its server (desktop-commander.write_file), so it is never in the list of file tools

mutations.name: AG-gate-guard-denied
mutations.what: a refusal carries the guard

mutations.name: AG-gate-guard-none
mutations.what: an approval carries no guard

mutations.name: AG-gate-card
mutations.what: the card is not put into the request

mutations.name: AG-gate-mask
mutations.what: the card is not masked

mutations.name: AG-gate-text
mutations.what: the text of the request carries the rows

mutations.name: AG-gate-batch-content
mutations.what: the list of a batch carries the content of its files

mutations.name: AG-gate-batch-kind
mutations.what: a batch has the card of a tool it is not

mutations.name: AG-gate-protected
mutations.what: a refused write of a protected file keeps what was to be written

mutations.name: AG-gate-keys
mutations.what: a call that touches a private key keeps the words the model wrote

mutations.name: AG-gate-edit-hidden
mutations.what: the words of an edit of a protected file are kept

mutations.name: AG-gate-patch-path
mutations.what: the card of a patch has no path

mutations.name: AG-manager-guard
